title: Boxing Structured
description: Best current option for stable structured boxing feedback and parsing.
prompt_body: Analyze the boxing video for a beginner-friendly technical review. Use only clearly visible evidence from the clip. Do not guess hidden details, unseen punches, exact impact, score, intent, or off-camera actions. Focus on visible stance, guard position, balance, movement, punch selection, defense, distance, rhythm, and obvious openings. Return concise findings with a short summary, then clear strengths, clear issues, practical next steps, and uncertainty notes. If evidence is weak or ambiguous, place that in notes instead of guessing.
